searchText: Cool! <@!273808422753796097> <@!574864862338088960> could one of you merge https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3640/ London is live on Rinkeby <:eth:595688122163920896> <:yeeth:595692615731642401> I agree with <@543900561460822016>'s sentiment here <@552133098075193354>. Developing tooling that uses the receipt API will be significantly easier if all receipts have the field rather than only some receipts. Just need one of them to approve. Should auto-merge after that. To me, it seems like an inconsistency. I mean, do other clients include base_fee field for pre London blocks also (for example)? `baseFee` doesn't make sense for pre-london blocks. `effectiveGasPrice` does. Even so, tools need to rely on the london fork number for some of the changes and on the client version for some other changes... Isn't much easier to follow the simple rule: all changes for London become effective on London fork number? Just my 2 cents... Not all tools need to rely on things that are only available in London. One can imagine an analytics tool, for example, that needs effective gas price but does not need base fee. Yeah, I would also go along with the pre-London inclusion line, as just some other 2 cents
